posts.text: If you are looking for a free LLM API to develop maybe a prototype of your AI product, or just casually build an AI project for your practice, instead of using self hosted model on @ollama , you can surely try @GoogleAIStudio, they provide decent models like @GeminiApp 2.5 flash. https://t.co/gxk4zffWme
@GoogleAIStudio When I start seeing clear indication that top people using Claude or ChatGPT are switching over I’ll try it too. Or maybe with a free allotment of credits
@GoogleAIStudio Nothing. Gemini flash models are useless for what I'd like to make unless you decide to give the image models a free tier again... Until then, Gemini 4 pro is long overdue.
@GoogleAIStudio Would you borrow me some free api tokens if i share my idea 😆
@AmbsdOP @GoogleAIStudio See the free tools already available via Pinokio and @ComfyUI on your own PC ;)

author.name: Technomantics™ - °A Shrewd Skew° heading to Steam

posts.text: @KeridwenCodet @samsheffer @GoogleDeepMind @GoogleAIStudio I mean you are free to use it however you like, it just turned out to be an effective combination for me.

@samsheffer @GoogleDeepMind @GoogleAIStudio Hi Sam.

In order to assess this properly I need to try it against MY repos.

I can’t do that with the very limited token allowance on antigravity.

Would really have been better to provide users with true free access so they can evaluate for YOU properly
